full_text_zh:
[P1] 中国
经典神话故事
绘本
后羿射日
哈皮童年 编绘
海峡出版发行集团 福建科学技术出版社

[P2] 很久很久以前，天上有十个太阳。

[P3] 这十个太阳都是天帝的孩子，他们非常淘气，
经常会偷偷地跑到世界最东边的东海游泳。

[P4] 当十个太阳脱掉外衣进入大海，会瞬间变成十只火鸟。他们不停地在水中嬉戏玩耍，十分开心。

[P5] 十兄弟玩得正高兴的时候，老大提醒今天该谁值日了。原来天帝给他们的任务就是每天必须有一个人从东边升起，西边降落，每天一换。
这样，每天清晨都会有一个太阳从东边升起，用他的身体给大地万物带去光明和热量。

[P6] 那时候，人和动物像朋友一样生活在一起。动物将它们的后代放在窝里，农民把谷物堆在田野里，彼此相安无事。

[P7] 人们日出而作，日落而息，按时作息，生活美满。

动物们每天也日出寻食，吃饱后就和
人们一起玩耍，它们都感谢太阳带来的光
明和欢乐。

[P8] 可是，有一天这十个太阳心血来潮，心想：要是我们兄弟十个一起遨游天空，肯定很有趣。
想到就做到，当黎明来临，他们就一起飞上了天空。

[P9] 当十个太阳一起出现在天空时，万物开始遭殃了——辛勤的农夫热得倒在地上没法干活，水里的鱼也热得跳来跳去，土地开始干裂，树木花草开始枯萎。

[P10] 森林着火啦，烧成了灰烬，烧死了许多动物。一些侥幸逃生的动物饿极了，只得到处流窜，寻找食物。

[P11] 河流干枯了，大海也干涸了。所有的鱼都死了，水中的怪物便爬上岸偷窃食物。
没有吃的和喝的，人们又饿又渴。很多人坚持不住，死去了。

[P12] 为了生存下去，有些人冒着高温外出觅食，反倒成了野兽的食物。

[P13] 这时，有个年轻英俊的英雄名叫后羿，他是个百发百中的神箭手。他看到人们生活在苦难中，便决心帮助大家脱离苦海，射掉天上多余的九个太阳。

[P14] 后羿爬过九十九座
高山，渡过九十九
条大河，穿过九十九道峡谷，来到东
海边，登上了一座
大山。

后羿拉开万斤力的弓，搭
上千斤重的利箭，瞄准天上火
辣辣的太阳，“嗖”地一箭射去，
第一个太阳被射落了。他又
拉开弓，搭上利箭，“嗖”地一
箭射去，同时射落了两个太阳。

[P15] 天上还有七个太阳，仍很炙热。后羿又狠狠地射了一箭，一箭射落了四个太阳，其他太阳吓得全身打颤，后羿还是一箭接一箭地射，太阳们的羽毛纷纷落在地上，大地越来越暗。终于，天上只剩下一个太阳了。

[P16] 最后的那个太阳害怕得躲进了大海里，顿时，世界一片黑暗。人们无法生活，便请求天帝唤最后那个太阳出来。
第二天早上，五彩缤纷的朝霞映在东边的海面上，接着一轮金灿灿的太阳露出了海面。

[P17] 人们看到了太阳的光芒，高兴得手舞足蹈，齐声欢呼。从此，这个太阳每天早晨从东方的海面升起，温暖人间，让万物得以生存。
full_text_en:
[P1] China
Classic Mythological Stories
Picture Book
Hou Yi Shoots the Suns
Compiled and Illustrated by Happy Childhood
Strait Publishing and Distribution Group, Fujian Science and Technology Press

[P2] Long, long ago, there were ten suns in the sky.

[P3] These ten suns are the children of the Heavenly Emperor. They are very mischievous,
and often secretly swim in the Eastern Sea, the easternmost part of the world.

[P4] When the ten suns took off their outer clothes and entered the sea, they would instantly turn into ten firebirds. They played and frolicked in the water without stopping, feeling very happy.

[P5] While the ten brothers were playing happily, the eldest reminded them whose turn it was to be on duty. Originally, the Heavenly Emperor had assigned them the task of having one of them rise from the east and set in the west each day, rotating daily.
This way, every morning, one sun would rise from the east, using his body to bring light and warmth to all living things on Earth.

[P6] Back then, people and animals lived together like friends. Animals kept their young in nests, and farmers stored their grain in the fields, living in peace with one another.

[P7] People worked when the sun rose and rested when it set, following a regular schedule and living happily.

Animals also foraged for food when the sun rose, and after eating, they played with people. They all thanked the sun for bringing light and joy.

[P8] But one day, the ten suns got an idea. They thought: If we ten brothers travel together across the sky, it would be so much fun.
They acted on their idea. When dawn arrived, they all flew up into the sky together.

[P9] When ten suns appeared in the sky at once, all living things began to suffer—hardworking farmers grew so hot they collapsed on the ground and could not work, fish in the water jumped wildly from the heat, the land began to crack, and trees and flowers started to wither.

[P10] The forest is on fire, turned to ashes, and many animals were burned to death. Some animals who managed to escape are starving, and can only wander around, searching for food.

[P11] The rivers dried up, and the oceans became barren. All the fish died, and monsters from the water climbed ashore to steal food.
With no food or drink, people grew hungry and thirsty. Many could not endure and died.

[P12] In order to survive, some people ventured out in the extreme heat to find food, only to become prey for wild beasts.

[P13] At this time, there was a young and handsome hero named Hou Yi, who was a divine archer with a hundred percent accuracy. Seeing people suffering, he resolved to help them escape their misery by shooting down the nine extra suns in the sky.

[P14] Hou Yi climbed over ninety-nine mountains, crossed ninety-nine great rivers, and passed through ninety-nine valleys, arriving at the eastern sea shore, where he climbed onto a great mountain.

Hou Yi drew his bow of ten-thousand-jin strength, placed a sharp arrow weighing a thousand jin, aimed at the fiery suns in the sky, and with a 'whoosh' shot an arrow— the first sun was shot down. He drew his bow again, placed another sharp arrow, and with a 'whoosh' shot another arrow, simultaneously shooting down two suns.

[P15] There were still seven suns in the sky, and it was still scorching hot. Hou Yi shot another arrow fiercely, and with one shot, he brought down four suns. The remaining suns trembled with fear. Hou Yi continued to shoot arrow after arrow. The feathers of the suns fell to the ground, and the earth grew darker and darker. Finally, there was only one sun left in the sky.

[P16] The last sun, frightened, hid in the sea. Instantly, the world plunged into darkness. People could no longer live, so they begged the Heavenly Emperor to summon the last sun back.

The next morning, colorful dawn light reflected on the eastern sea, and then a bright, golden sun rose above the horizon.

[P17] People saw the light of the sun, danced with joy, and cheered together. From then on, this sun rose every morning from the eastern sea, warming the world and allowing all living things to survive.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《后羿射日》的封面，展示了后羿拉弓射日的场景，上方有书名、系列名称和编绘者信息，下方有出版社信息。
[P2] 本页描绘了远古时代天空中同时出现十个太阳的景象，文字说明了故事的开端。
[P3] 本页描绘了天空中十个太阳同时出现的景象，文字说明它们是天帝的孩子，性格淘气，常偷偷去东海游泳。
[P4] 本页描绘了十个太阳化身为火鸟在东海中嬉戏的场景，文字说明了他们脱下外衣后变成火鸟，在水中玩耍的快乐情景。
[P5] 本页描绘了十个太阳在东海嬉戏时，老大提醒轮值，说明他们每天需轮流升起和降落，为大地带来光明和热量。
[P6] 本页描绘了远古时代人与动物和谐共处的景象，文字说明了当时人们与动物彼此信任、相安无事的生活状态。
[P7] 本页描绘了远古时代人们日出而作、日落而息的和谐生活，以及动物们与人类共同玩耍、感谢太阳带来光明与欢乐的场景。
[P8] 十个太阳心血来潮，决定一起飞上天空遨游，打破了轮流值班的规矩。
[P9] 十个太阳同时出现在天空，导致大地酷热难耐，农夫无法劳作，鱼儿跳动，土地干裂，植物枯萎，万物遭受苦难。
[P10] 本页描绘了十个太阳同时出现导致森林大火的惨状，文字说明了森林被烧毁、动物死亡或流离失所的后果。
[P11] 本页描绘了十个太阳同时出现导致的灾难性后果：河流干涸、鱼死、怪物出没，人们饥渴难耐，许多人因此死去。
[P12] 本页描绘了十个太阳同时出现导致的灾难性后果：人们在酷热中外出觅食，却遭到野兽攻击，成为其食物，画面中老虎正吞噬一人，另一人惊恐躲藏。
[P13] 本页描绘了英雄后羿在十个太阳同时出现导致大地酷热、生灵涂炭的背景下，决心挺身而出，用神箭射落多余太阳的场景。
[P14] 本页描绘了英雄后羿历经艰险抵达东海之滨，随后拉开神弓，接连射落多个太阳的场景，展现了他拯救苍生的决心与勇力。
[P15] 后羿继续射落太阳，一箭射下四个，其余太阳惊恐颤抖，最终天空只剩下一个太阳，大地逐渐变暗。
[P16] 本页描述了最后一个太阳因恐惧躲入大海，导致世界陷入黑暗，人们请求天帝召回太阳；次日清晨，新的太阳升起，万物重见光明。
[P17] 本页描绘了最后一个太阳升起后，人们欢欣鼓舞，大地重获光明与生机的场景。
